name: marketnow-mcp
description: MarketNow MCP Server v1.14.2 — Trust layer for agent commerce: 68,388 index-certified MCP skills (132,737 total tracked), two-level Sentinel security (L1 index certification on every entry, L2 deep-scan of npm tarballs), Agent Trust Card verification in both formats (ATC/3.0-core production envelopes with real Ed25519 RFC 8032 + RFC 8785 JCS against the embedded CA key registry — fail-closed on unknown/compromised keys — and the original ATC/1.0 8-control conformance path), OCSP-style revocation checks against the signed MNR-CRL-1.0 registry, and TFP-1.0 cryptographic tool fingerprinting (SHA-256 over JCS-canonical definitions) for tool-poisoning defense. 15 tools, all under the marketnow_* namespace (snake_case, deterministic prefix) with strict JSON-Schema (type+enum+pattern+bounds), intent-oriented descriptions, and structured {content, isError} responses with INVALID_ARGUMENT/NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN_TOOL error taxonomy. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, LangChain, and LlamaIndex agents. Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. ATC/1.0 spec published at github.com/alicelabs-llc/marketnow/tree/master/docs/atc-spec. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).
author: AliceLabs LLC <info@alicelabs.site>
